findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/WeylGroup.lean:114 `range_weylGroup_weightHom : MonoidHom.range ((Equiv.weightHom P).domRestrict P.weylGroup) = Subgroup.closure (range P.reflection)`; :139 `weylGroup_apply_root (g : P.weylGroup) (i : ι) : g • P.root i = P.root (P.weylGroupToPerm g i)`
findings.fix: Delete both. Use `P.range_weylGroup_weightHom` to get `g ∈ P.weylGroup` with `w = Equiv.weightHom P g`. Then `P.weylGroup_apply_root g i` shows that `w` sends each root to a root, so `Submodule.span_le`/`Submodule.map_span` give `(P.rootSpan ℤ).map w ≤ P.rootSpan ℤ`.
findings.issue: The private `rootSpanStabilizer` subgroup and `reflection_mem_rootSpanStabilizer` rebuild, by hand, the fact that Weyl-group elements send roots to roots, only to prove `mem_rootSpan_of_mem_closure_range_reflection`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Defs.lean:261 `lemma reflection_same (x : M) : P.reflection i (P.reflection i x) = x`
findings.fix: Delete `hinv` and pass `RootPairing.reflection_same` to the `simp only` call instead.
findings.issue: The local `hinv : ∀ y, P.reflection j (P.reflection j y) = y` re-derives a lemma Mathlib already has, going through `reflection_inv` and `symm_apply_apply`.

summary: The affine reflections and the Q ⋊ W description of the affine Weyl group are new, but the proof that the Weyl group preserves the root lattice rebuilds Mathlib's Weyl-group root permutation, and some helper lemmas restate existing API. These are fixable duplications, not grounds to block.
